task: Find the top-rated hotel in Manhattan, NY, suitable for 4 guests, and identify the fastest public transportation option from the hotel to LGA airport.
agent_final_answer:
Top-rated hotel in Manhattan, NY suitable for 4 guests: PESTANA PARK AVENUE - 4.8 stars (1,167 reviews), 23 E 39th St, Murray Hill/Midtown. (Found via Google Maps Hotels with guests set to 4 and results sorted by rating; it ranks #1 at 4.8, ahead of The Wall Street Hotel and Pendry Manhattan West, which are also 4.8.)

Fastest public transportation option from the hotel to LaGuardia Airport (LGA): about 47 minutes, which Google Maps explicitly labels the "Fastest trip." Route: walk to Grand Central-42 St, ride the 7 subway to Vernon Blvd-Jackson Av, then take the Q70 Select Bus (LaGuardia Link) to LaGuardia Airport. Departs ~7:22 PM, arrives ~8:09 PM; fare about $3.00. (Other transit itineraries run ~46-55 min, e.g. subway plus the M60+ bus.)
